text.autoconfig.wanderingtraveler.title: Wandering Traveler
text.autoconfig.wanderingtraveler.option: Show Biome Titles
Turn the whole mod off without removing it.
Use the 3D Artwork
Off draws every title as plain text instead.
Announce Dimensions
Name the dimension when you go through a portal, then the biome you arrive in.
The Overworld, the Nether and the End all have their own artwork.
Show Tooltips
The little explanations that appear when you hover over a setting.
Off hides all of them, including this one. Applies as soon as you save.
Size: Short Names
Percent. Names like Taiga, Ocean and Desert.
Size: Medium Names
Percent. Names like Cherry Grove and Frozen Peaks.
Size: Long Names
Percent. Names like Windswept Gravelly Hills. Smaller so they still fit.
Size: Plain Text
Percent, for biomes that have no artwork yet.
Most modded biomes land here.
Plain Text Colour
The colour of a title drawn as plain text.
The 3D artwork keeps its own colours and is not affected.
Plain Text Shadow
The drop shadow behind a title drawn as plain text.
Match Shadow to Text Colour
Work the shadow colour out from the text colour, the way the rest of the game does.
Turn it off to choose the shadow colour yourself below.
Plain Text Shadow Colour
Only used when the setting above is off.
While it is on, this shows the colour that was worked out for you.
Position on Screen
Each position already clears the HUD: the middle row sits on the crosshair,
and the bottom row sits above the hotbar. The nudges below are extra.
Nudge Right
Pixels at the current GUI scale. Negative moves left.
Nudge Down
Pixels at the current GUI scale. Negative moves up.
Fade In
Ticks. 20 ticks is one second.
Time on Screen
Ticks at full opacity, before the fade out starts.
Fade Out
Ticks. 20 ticks is one second.
Minimum Time Between Titles
Ticks a title keeps the screen before the next one may take it.
Cross several biomes quickly and you see the first, then the one you ended up in.
Set it to 0 to let every title replace the last one at once.
Hide While Flying With an Elytra
The biome you land in is still announced.
Surface Biomes While Underground
What to do, while you are in a cave, with a biome that also exists at the surface.
Cave biomes always show, whatever this is set to.
Show a Title
How often the same place is worth announcing.
Biomes that display the same name count as one place.
How Many to Remember
Only used by "Not if I have seen it recently" above.
Skip the Biome You Spawn In
On, joining a world announces nothing, because you did not travel anywhere.
Never Show These
Biome or dimension ids, one per row. A name on its own is treated as a vanilla one.
A name that matches nothing is simply never used, so a typo is harmless.
wanderingtraveler.showwhen.always: Every time I cross a border
wanderingtraveler.showwhen.not_seen_rece: Not if I have seen it recently
wanderingtraveler.showwhen.first_time_on: Only the first time I see it
